bio: Benjamin Pringle (24 Jan 1794 - 6 Jan 1853) married Charity Gould (b. 1800, granddaughter of Thomas and Charity (Lamoreaux) Davenport). His 1853 PA death and burial record names 'Sam Pringle & Martha'. Children: Bethia (m. Caleb Roberts 1852, Iowa), Martha Ann (m. William Hutchinson), Lege (1825), Ira (1833), Jacob Gould (m. (1) VanScoy, (2) the widow Ellen C. (Fuller) Nesbitt, 1864), Martin (California) and Caleb (b. 1839, 'went West'). Proves Benjamin was one of Samuel and Martha's five sons.
sources: Giles & Franklin, Thomas Davenport, Philipstown Pioneer 1682-1759, and his Descendants (1962): https://archive.org/details/thomasdavenportp00gile (also HathiTrust wu.89066038563: https://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=wu.89066038563&view=1up&seq=395) pp.280-281
